children: Genius plans to introduce revenue-funded buybacks and burns on 31 Oct 2026. A portion of revenue from Genius App will fund purchases of GENIUS on the market, with the purchased tokens permanently burned.

The mechanism gives app revenue a direct role in reducing token supply, since tokens bought for burns leave circulation permanently. Genius has not stated the share of revenue allocated to buybacks or the planned burn amounts.
A portion of the revenue generated by the Genius App will be allocated to buying back
from the market and permanently burning those tokens.
A direct connection between our product's activity and the token's supply.

title: Genius: Introduces revenue-funded GENIUS buybacks and burns - 31 Oct 2026
